card.name: "Used" before "in combination with"
card.fires_on: The word "used" (or "in") right after "when", "is" or "or", where the next words are "in combination with" or "concomitantly with" another drug.

modes.label: when used in combination
modes.description: "used" after "when" in drug-interaction statements, just before "in combination with" a named drug.
modes.example: a lower dosage of insulin or insulin secretagogue may be required to minimize the risk of hypoglycemia when<< used>> in combination with alogliptin

modes.label: alone or in combination
modes.description: "in" after "single agent or", just before "combination with".
modes.example: occurring in 16% of patients receiving KEYTRUDA as a single agent or<< in>> combination with platinum and

card.writes: It pushes toward words meaning "with" or "together with" (mostly Chinese tokens), which fit the coming "combination with" phrase.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a label where the text is about to say a drug is given together with another drug.
